## Motivation

With `--enable-deterministic-inference` on ROCm (gfx950), compressed-tensors FP8 models with per-channel weight scales are not deterministic. `RedHatAI/*-FP8-dynamic` is the common example. For `RedHatAI/Qwen3-8B-FP8-dynamic` at TP1 with every other deterministic-mode fix in place:
- `single` returns 3 different outputs in 50;
- `prefix` returns 19-22 per prompt;
- a bitwise batch-size check keeps the same tokens in only 890 of 1,275 responses.

Two paths cause it:

- **Linears:** AITER per-token quantization plus the CK `gemm_a8w8_bpreshuffle` kernel, which picks its kernel by the number of tokens.
- **Experts (MoE):** AITER's fused MoE, where a token's result depends on the other tokens in its batch.

## Modifications

Depends on #46791 (first two commits: experts preshuffled only for the AITER runner; K taken from the tensors on the Triton runner). This PR's own changes are the last two commits:

- **Linears:** `fp8_utils.py` adds `apply_fp8_channel_linear_batch_invariant` and `compressed_tensors_w8a8_fp8.py` uses it for channel-wise linears in deterministic mode on ROCm. The weight stays unshuffled, and `triton_scaled_mm` runs with a fixed tile that depends only on N (`_batch_invariant_fp8_channel_tile`: 128x256x64 from N >= 16,384, else 128x128x128). One program per output tile loops over K, so every row is reduced in the same order at any batch size.
- **Experts:** `compressed_tensors_w8a8_fp8_moe.py` makes the automatic runner choice pick the Triton MoE runner in deterministic mode, and the experts stay unshuffled for it. The Triton runner uses one fixed config in deterministic mode. An explicitly requested runner is kept.
- **Tests:** the CPU test from #46791 gets a deterministic-mode case.
- **Unchanged:** normal mode, CUDA, and block-scaled FP8.

## Accuracy Tests

MI350X, ROCm 7.2.4, `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261021`, deterministic mode, default server settings.

Checks:
- `python3 -m sglang.test.test_deterministic`: `single`, `prefix`, `prefix --return-logprob`, `radix_cache`, 50 trials;
- a bitwise batch-size check: the same prompt in batches of 1 to 50, 1,275 responses, token IDs and logprobs compared exactly with the batch-size-1 response.

GSM8K: sgl-eval 0.1.2, temperature 0, 1,319 questions.

| Model (`RedHatAI/...-FP8-dynamic`) | TP | before: `single` outputs / bitwise identical | this PR: every check | GSM8K before / this PR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3-8B | 1 | 3 / 890 | passes, 1,275 / 1,275 | 93.33% / 92.95% |
| Qwen3-8B | 2, 4 | | passes, 1,275 / 1,275 | 92.57% (TP2) |
| phi-4 | 1 | 2 / 586 | passes, 1,275 / 1,275 | 95.30% |
| Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct | 1, 2 | 3 / 890 | passes, 1,275 / 1,275 | 80.21% |
| Qwen3-32B | 2, 4 | 2 / 528 | passes, 1,275 / 1,275 | 94.92% |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B (MoE) | 1 | 21 / 6 with only the linears changed (experts on AITER) | passes, 1,275 / 1,275 | 94.77% / 94.62% |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B (MoE) | 2 | | passes, 1,275 / 1,275 | 95.22% |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B (MoE) | 4 | | passes | 95.45% |
| Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct | 4 | | passes | |

Further checks:
- **Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct:** every check passes.
- **Long context:** Qwen3-8B with YaRN x4. Prompts of 8k, 32k and 64k tokens give identical output alone and among 15 other requests (9 / 9).
- **AIME25** (pass@1 over 8 repeats, deterministic mode):
  - Qwen3-8B: 59.6% before, 70.0% with this PR (the 8 repeats are now identical);
  - Qwen3-30B-A3B: 71.7% before, 70.0% with this PR.
- **Unit test:** 5 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Deterministic mode, `python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-range-ratio 1.0 --request-rate inf`. Output throughput, before vs this PR; 1k/1k is 256 prompts at concurrency 256, 8k/1k is 256 prompts at concurrency 128:

| Model | TP | 1k in / 1k out | 8k in / 1k out |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3-8B | 1 | 4,265 -> 4,084 tok/s (-4.3%) | 945 -> 917 tok/s (-3.0%) |
| phi-4 | 1 | 3,415 -> 3,287 tok/s (-3.8%) | 681 -> 662 tok/s (-2.8%) |
| Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct | 1 | 3,194 -> 3,106 tok/s (-2.8%) | 957 -> 931 tok/s (-2.7%) |
| Qwen3-32B | 2 | 3,391 -> 3,193 tok/s (-5.8%) | 761 -> 728 tok/s (-4.3%) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B (MoE) | 1 | 5,043 -> 4,657 tok/s (-7.7%) | 1,182 -> 1,081 tok/s (-8.6%) |

The cost comes from `triton_scaled_mm` and the Triton MoE runner replacing CK and AITER kernels. For Llama-3.3-70B TP4, starting the larger tile at N >= 12,288 instead of 16,384 was slower end to end (-3.6% at 1k/1k, -1.6% at 8k/1k), so the threshold stays.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+"""CPU tests for where compressed-tensors channel-wise FP8 experts run on ROCm.
+
+The experts are preshuffled for AITER's fused MoE only when that runner is used;
+the Triton runner reads them unshuffled. Deterministic mode moves the automatic
+choice to the Triton runner.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+from compressed_tensors.quantization import QuantizationStrategy
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe import MoeRunnerBackend
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.compressed_tensors.schemes import (
+    compressed_tensors_w8a8_fp8_moe as scheme_module,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+
+def _scheme(strategy):
+    scheme = scheme_module.CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoE.__new__(
+        scheme_module.CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8MoE
+    )
+    scheme.weight_quant = SimpleNamespace(strategy=strategy)
+    return scheme
+
+
+def _exec(deterministic):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        deterministic=SimpleNamespace(enable_deterministic_inference=deterministic)
+    )
+
+
+class TestChannelExpertsOnAiter(CustomTestCase):
+    def _on_aiter(
+        self,
+        runner,
+        use_aiter=True,
+        strategy=QuantizationStrategy.CHANNEL,
+        deterministic=False,
+    ):
+        a2a = SimpleNamespace(supports_aiter=lambda: True)
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(scheme_module, "_is_hip", True),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                scheme_module, "get_exec", return_value=_exec(deterministic)
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(scheme_module, "_use_aiter", use_aiter),
+            mock.patch.object(
+                scheme_module, "get_moe_runner_backend", return_value=runner
+            ),
+            mock.patch.object(scheme_module, "get_moe_a2a_backend", return_value=a2a),
+        ):
+            return _scheme(strategy)._channel_experts_on_aiter()
+
